verdict.rationale: USCIS runs a developer platform (Torch) with a Case Status API and a FOIA request API, so bulk operations are a fair axis for this service. Nothing in the evidence shows batch or bulk capabilities: the Case Status API is described only as giving 'regular access' to status information, and online filing goes one form at a time through myUSCIS accounts, with no filing API. The axis applies but is unevidenced, so the verdict is none rather than na.
